## Design

### 2026-11-08: # oBento

**7h**

# oBento
I had no time during this week, hence everything was done today, on Sunday. Because of this, I decided to make a CAD design for something that would actually be useful to me when creating the other hardware projects. I also attempted to make the majority of this project without any guide, and by figuring it out myself, since I do have minimal experience on Onshape. My week's project is a stackable components organizer!

## What I did
For this project, I used Onshape again!
- Created the base
I started with a square, but I ended up making the dimensions based on variables in case I wanted to change the dimensions easly later on.

![Screenshot 2026-11-08 163625](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/s5X6uAidfBv2Me3zVHdgxREVUKqtvsIM/977247d13f20b61d1048e54c7d3f5ac083592c26919bb12c6d229417f1d911b5.png)

![Screenshot 2026-11-08 163538](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/s5X6uAidfBv2Me3zVHdgxREVUKqtvsIM/977cec35779ac892a8ce7e19bf14563c03ed2fa755ec69526021b454f0cb2b2c.png)

![Screenshot 2026-11-08 163402](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/s5X6uAidfBv2Me3zVHdgxREVUKqtvsIM/523c7d1beedc910aeb4731a7a4d9d31f2c6748ab2a8240db702b4b98b0864a99.png)

- Actually made the bases stackable, by remove extruding a small border of the bases.

![Screenshot 2026-11-08 170051](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/s5X6uAidfBv2Me3zVHdgxREVUKqtvsIM/8cd56f21a4e91f29f95eb188724b6bcf621ef810e2eac1f8e21d721f3e0fe112.png)

- Adding the inner walls.
I first tried extruding crossing lines, but this caused an error, so instead I extruded crossing thin rectangles.

![Screenshot 2026-11-08 173902](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/s5X6uAidfBv2Me3zVHdgxREVUKqtvsIM/4d090c56fc37aa352396d14ce89d3572eee18b87c7d7231abc12bc518a95ff0e.png)

![Screenshot 2026-11-08 173208](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/s5X6uAidfBv2Me3zVHdgxREVUKqtvsIM/ff22657f2fa671a781d7db5f06ddab738e194a58baf92f02a98b76d550de46b1.png)

- Added the lid.
To make the design process easier, I created the second part on top of the already existing base. I had to modify the inner walls of the base so that the lid could also be stackable.

![Screenshot 2026-11-08 183704](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/s5X6uAidfBv2Me3zVHdgxREVUKqtvsIM/932cc58c5cc5a46c2f35aad23fa9864aabf8876c7415344d825ba9d1dffab3a8.png)

I then added a crease so that the lid can easily be taken off the topmost base.

![Screenshot 2026-11-08 184008](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/s5X6uAidfBv2Me3zVHdgxREVUKqtvsIM/22d6c8abe1917d8b24941100bb29a763a4e869d48d44dfd7b869ea7211f9d5d1.png)

- Finally, I added tfillets to make the product more ergonomic.

![Screenshot 2026-11-08 184447](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/s5X6uAidfBv2Me3zVHdgxREVUKqtvsIM/2cba8bbad0f78bef95994eb1899d4e3ae57c8e77b2d138c608c37978d31d1f84.png)

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/s5X6uAidfBv2Me3zVHdgxREVUKqtvsIM/4c55cd0cbb76ded561d08b0c19bea7e390b28c2a8e3c964ee42bf6602985cc7e.png)

This reminded me of a Japanese bento box, hence I named this project oBento (which means a bento meal in Japanese).

- I made the GitHub repository after finishing the creation of the project 😭
- Created the README
- Looked into the 3D printing service. It will be the same business as the one from week 2. Since they are located locally, I can go pickup my design once they print it, hence I do not pay extra for delivery.
